text:
Estimated items before eating:
- Toast, 1 slice of whole grain: ~30 g, ~80 kcal
- 2 poached eggs: ~100 g, ~143 kcal
- Avocado, about a quarter to a third of a fruit: ~50 g, ~80 kcal
- Latte in a tall cup, about 250 ml, mostly milk: ~240 g, ~120 kcal

After eating, the plate has only smears of avocado and egg yolk left, so nearly everything was eaten. The cup has a little foam and coffee left, so I estimated about 90% of the latte was drunk.

Totals:
- Solid food: ~30 + 100 + 50 = 180 g, about 300 kcal. Allowing a small amount left on the plate gives roughly 290 kcal and 175 g.
- Latte: ~216 g drunk, about 108 kcal.
- Combined: about 400 kcal and 390 g.
